segments.sn30.7-16:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn30.7-16:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī”ti?
segments.sn30.7-16:1.4: “Idha, bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī.
segments.sn30.7-16:1.8: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.
segments.sn30.7-16:1.9: So annaṃ deti … pe … pānaṃ deti … vatthaṃ deti … yānaṃ deti … mālaṃ deti … gandhaṃ deti … vilepanaṃ deti … seyyaṃ deti … āvasathaṃ deti … padīpeyyaṃ deti.
segments.sn30.7-16:1.19: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.sn30.7-16:1.20: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ supaṇṇānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī”ti.
